_README: Label id -> structure name for the lower-limb bone volume of the Visible Human female (IDC series af18f5e4, femur-to-toes CT, 0.72 mm) by scripts/vhf_lower_limb_bones.py, plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Bone = HU >= 200 split at the joints by a distance-transform watershed (medullary canals tube-filled, 3.5 mm bone-core markers, fragments re-united where their common boundary is thick bone). Tibia = the largest component > 250 mm tall below the femur; fibula = the pieces lateral to the tibia within its height; patella = the largest component anterior to the distal femur; foot bones grouped by planes along the foot axis from the heel (tarsals < 115 mm, metatarsals 115-190, phalanges beyond). Femur = the legs-block femur (mid-thigh to condyles) united with the TotalSegmentator femur of her torso block (head to mid-thigh) after registration.

Registration legs -> torso block: the legs block starts at mid-thigh (no femoral head in it), so the shift comes from continuity across the junction (inter-femur distance, body and fat areas): x +6.0, y -3.6, z -943.5 mm, +-4 mm in z.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female, via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 femur labels.
